"""Prepare a pinned local repair release using existing scoped local-dev authority."""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
from uuid import uuid4
import zipfile

ART = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = ART.parents[1]
RELEASE = ART / "released"
SOURCE = RELEASE / "source"
OLD = Path(r"H:\PokemonFusionProject\fusion2\.codex-artifacts\necrozma-20261024")
candidate = sys.argv[1]
assert len(candidate) == 40 and all(c in "0123456789abcdef" for c in candidate)
assert subprocess.check_output(["git","rev-parse",candidate+"^{commit}"],cwd=ROOT,text=True).strip() == candidate
assert not RELEASE.exists(), "Never reuse a prior release target"
RELEASE.mkdir()
archive = RELEASE / "source.zip"
subprocess.run(["git","archive","--format=zip","--output="+str(archive),candidate],cwd=ROOT,check=True)
SOURCE.mkdir()
with zipfile.ZipFile(archive) as bundle:
    assert all((SOURCE / row.filename).resolve().is_relative_to(SOURCE.resolve()) for row in bundle.infolist())
    bundle.extractall(SOURCE)
qualified = json.loads((ROOT/".codex-artifacts/item-z-sources-863-20261025/accepted-scope.json").read_text())["python_sources"]
tracked = subprocess.check_output(["git","ls-tree","-r","--name-only",candidate],cwd=ROOT,text=True).splitlines()
manifest = {name:hashlib.sha256((SOURCE/name).read_text(encoding="utf-8").encode()).hexdigest()
            for name in tracked if name.endswith(".py")}
assert manifest == qualified, "Release Python must exactly match final accepted source"
(RELEASE/"source-manifest.json").write_text(json.dumps(manifest,indent=2)+"\n")
settings=(OLD/"released-retry/source/server/conf/qa_necrozma_settings.py").read_text()
settings=settings.replace("Native Necrozma QA", "Item Repair QA").replace("necrozma", "item_repair")
(SOURCE/"server/conf/qa_item_repair_settings.py").write_text(settings,encoding="utf-8")
for name in ("staff.py","staff_transport.py","socket_driver.py","run_player.py"):
    content=(OLD/"released-retry"/name).read_text()
    content=content.replace("qa_necrozma_settings","qa_item_repair_settings")
    content=content.replace("Native","ItemRepair").replace("Necrozma","Item Repair").replace("necrozma_qa","item_repair_qa")
    (RELEASE/name).write_text(content,encoding="utf-8")
supervisor=(OLD/"release_supervise_retry.py").read_text()
supervisor=supervisor.replace("RELEASE = ART / 'released-retry'", "RELEASE = ART / 'released'")
supervisor=supervisor.replace("qa_necrozma_settings","qa_item_repair_settings").replace("NativeQAStaff","ItemRepairQAStaff")
supervisor=supervisor.replace("(ART/'postgres-fixture.json')", "Path(r'H:\\PokemonFusionProject\\fusion2\\.codex-artifacts\\necrozma-20261024\\postgres-fixture.json')")
supervisor=supervisor.replace("approved_local_release_and_tagged_qa","existing_local_dev_authorization")
supervisor=supervisor.replace(
    "# This is a new release operation requiring its own explicit approval;\n    # the earlier rehearsal-only approval is deliberately insufficient.",
    "# This fresh isolated release uses the user's existing broad local-dev\n    # authorization, with exact candidate/tag/ports and task-owned schema guards.")
(ART/"supervise.py").write_text(supervisor,encoding="utf-8")
plan={"tag":"item-repair-release-"+uuid4().hex,"candidate":candidate,"repository":str(ROOT),
      "source":str(SOURCE),"ports":{"telnet":53301,"http":53302,"web":53303,"amp":53304,"websocket":53305},
      "source_manifest_sha256":hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(manifest,sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest(),
      "qa_settings_sha256":hashlib.sha256((SOURCE/"server/conf/qa_item_repair_settings.py").read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
      "scope":"New disposable archived loopback release only; no existing local/PF2-Dev game data, service, restart or permanent stock",
      "authority":"User's prior broad local-dev authorization plus current request to finish the remaining item issues; exact new target bound here"}
(RELEASE/"plan.json").write_text(json.dumps(plan,indent=2)+"\n")
authorization={"candidate":candidate,"tag":plan["tag"],"existing_local_dev_authorization":True,
               "basis":["Try again, I approve you to do what you need over the local dev server.",
                        "Go ahead and work your way though the rest of the items issues"],
               "limits":plan["scope"]}
(RELEASE/"operator-approval.json").write_text(json.dumps(authorization,indent=2)+"\n")
for path in [ART/"supervise.py", *RELEASE.glob("*.py"), SOURCE/"server/conf/qa_item_repair_settings.py"]:
    compile(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"),str(path),"exec")
print(json.dumps({"prepared_candidate":candidate,"python_sources":len(manifest),"ports":plan["ports"],
                  "database_or_service_operations":False,"scope":plan["scope"]}))

"""Approved-only fresh local released instance; clean up only its schema/processes."""
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import secrets
import socket
import subprocess
import sys
import time

ART = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
RELEASE = ART / 'released'
PLAN = json.loads((RELEASE/'plan.json').read_text())
SOURCE = Path(PLAN['source'])
assert SOURCE.resolve() == (RELEASE/'source').resolve()
approval = json.loads((RELEASE/'operator-approval.json').read_text())
assert approval['candidate'] == PLAN['candidate'] and approval['tag'] == PLAN['tag']
assert approval['existing_local_dev_authorization'] is True
os.environ['PF2_TEST_POSTGRES_DSN'] = json.loads(Path(r'H:\PokemonFusionProject\fusion2\.codex-artifacts\necrozma-20261024\postgres-fixture.json').read_text())['dsn']
os.environ['PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE']='1'
sys.path.insert(0,str(SOURCE/'tests/integration'))
sys.path.insert(0,str(SOURCE))
from isolated_postgres import IsolatedPostgres


def save(name,value):
    """Keep credentials/config private; public output contains no login secrets."""
    (RELEASE/name).write_text(json.dumps(value,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')


def cli(action,env):
    """Only this clone's different AMP port can receive its start/stop command."""
    with (RELEASE/('cli-'+action+'.log')).open('w',encoding='utf-8') as output:
        return subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-B','-m','evennia.server.evennia_launcher',
            '--settings','qa_item_repair_settings.py',action],cwd=SOURCE,env=env,
            stdout=output,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,creationflags=getattr(subprocess,'CREATE_NO_WINDOW',0),timeout=180)


manifest=json.loads((RELEASE/'source-manifest.json').read_text())
assert all(hashlib.sha256((SOURCE/path).read_text(encoding='utf-8').encode()).hexdigest()==digest
    for path,digest in manifest.items())
assert hashlib.sha256((SOURCE/'server/conf/qa_item_repair_settings.py').read_bytes()).hexdigest()==PLAN['qa_settings_sha256']
for port in PLAN['ports'].values():
    with socket.socket() as probe:
        probe.bind(('127.0.0.1',port))
database = IsolatedPostgres()
database.__enter__()
attempted=False
stopped=False
try:
    # This fresh isolated release uses the user's existing broad local-dev
    # authorization, with exact candidate/tag/ports and task-owned schema guards.
    from django.db import connection
    from django.db.migrations.executor import MigrationExecutor
    executor=MigrationExecutor(connection)
    target=executor.loader.graph.leaf_nodes()
    executor.migrate(target)
    assert not MigrationExecutor(connection).migration_plan(target)
    with connection.cursor() as cursor:
        cursor.execute('SELECT current_schema()')
        assert cursor.fetchone()[0]==database.schema
        cursor.execute('SELECT count(*) FROM objects_objectdb')
        assert cursor.fetchone()[0]==0
    config=dict(connection.settings_dict)
    config['OPTIONS']=dict(config['OPTIONS'],application_name=PLAN['tag'])
    save('runtime-private.json',{'tag':PLAN['tag'],'candidate':PLAN['candidate'],
        'schema':database.schema,'database':config,'ports':PLAN['ports'],
        'secret_key':secrets.token_urlsafe(64),
        'staff_username':'ItemRepairQAStaff'+secrets.token_hex(4),'staff_password':secrets.token_urlsafe(32)})
    env=os.environ.copy()
    env.pop('PF2_NO_EVENNIA',None)
    env.update(PYTHONPATH=str(SOURCE),DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE='server.conf.qa_item_repair_settings',PYTHONIOENCODING='utf-8')
    with (RELEASE/'staff-init.log').open('w',encoding='utf-8') as output:
        result=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-B',str(RELEASE/'staff.py'),'init'],cwd=SOURCE,env=env,
            stdout=output,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,creationflags=getattr(subprocess,'CREATE_NO_WINDOW',0))
    assert result.returncode==0,'New private operator init failed'
    save('supervisor-state.json',{'phase':'starting','pid':os.getpid(),'candidate':PLAN['candidate'],
        'schema':database.schema,'source':str(SOURCE),'ports':PLAN['ports']})
    try:
        attempted=True
        assert cli('start',env).returncode==0,'Private release startup failed'
        deadline=time.monotonic()+180
        while time.monotonic()<deadline:
            try:
                with socket.create_connection(('127.0.0.1',PLAN['ports']['telnet']),timeout=2):
                    pass
                from evennia.objects.models import ObjectDB
                assert ObjectDB.objects.filter(pk=2).exists()
                break
            except (OSError,AssertionError):
                time.sleep(.5)
        else:
            raise RuntimeError('New QA loopback server did not become ready')
        save('supervisor-state.json',{'phase':'ready','pid':os.getpid(),'candidate':PLAN['candidate'],
            'schema':database.schema,'ports':PLAN['ports'],'source_manifest_sha256':PLAN['source_manifest_sha256']})
        print('LOCAL_NATIVE_RELEASE_READY '+PLAN['candidate'],flush=True)
        while not (RELEASE/'cleanup-requested').exists():
            time.sleep(.5)
    finally:
        if attempted:
            cli('stop',env)
        open_ports=[]
        for _ in range(60):
            open_ports=[]
            for name in ('telnet','http','web','amp','websocket'):
                try:
                    with socket.create_connection(('127.0.0.1',PLAN['ports'][name]),timeout=.2):
                        open_ports.append(name)
                except OSError:
                    pass
            if not open_ports:
                break
            time.sleep(.5)
        assert not open_ports,'Retain schema until remaining task listeners are reviewed'
        stopped=True
        save('supervisor-state.json',{'phase':'stopped','candidate':PLAN['candidate'],
            'schema':database.schema,'ports_closed':True,'existing_services_changed':False})
finally:
    if not attempted or stopped:
        database.close()
        print('Private release stopped; its generated schema dropped.',flush=True)
    else:
        print('Private schema retained for explicit task-process cleanup.',flush=True)

"""In-process observation only: current source attribution and ordinary battle state."""
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import sys
from django.conf import settings
from django.db import connection
from evennia.objects.models import ObjectDB

ART=Path(r"H:\PokemonFusionProject\fusion2-necrozma-items\.codex-artifacts\item-release-860-20261025")
RELEASE=ART/"released"
config=json.loads((RELEASE/"runtime-private.json").read_text())
plan=json.loads((RELEASE/"plan.json").read_text())
assert config["candidate"]==plan["candidate"] and config["tag"]==plan["tag"]
assert re.fullmatch("[a-z0-9-]+",QA_LABEL)
SOURCE=Path(plan["source"]).resolve()
assert Path(settings.GAME_DIR).resolve()==SOURCE
with connection.cursor() as cursor:
    cursor.execute("SELECT current_schema()")
    assert cursor.fetchone()[0]==config["schema"]
manifest=json.loads((RELEASE/"source-manifest.json").read_text())
modules={}
for name in ("pokemon.battle.engine","pokemon.battle.logic","pokemon.dex.functions.items_funcs",
             "pokemon.dex.functions.abilities_funcs","pokemon.dex.functions.moves.damage_moves",
             "pokemon.battle.z_generic_pairs"):
    module=sys.modules.get(name)
    if module is None:
        modules[name]={"loaded":False}
        continue
    path=Path(module.__file__).resolve()
    assert path.is_relative_to(SOURCE)
    relative=str(path.relative_to(SOURCE)).replace("\\","/")
    digest=hashlib.sha256(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").encode()).hexdigest()
    assert digest==manifest[relative]
    modules[name]={"loaded":True,"path":relative,"sha256_lf":digest}
names=[row["name"] for row in json.loads((RELEASE/"player-private.json").read_text()).values()]
players=list(ObjectDB.objects.filter(db_key__in=names,db_typeclass_path="pokemon.user.User").order_by("pk"))
battles={}
for player in players:
    session=player.ndb.battle_instance
    if session is None or session.battle is None:
        continue
    battle=session.battle
    battles[str(session.battle_id)]={"turn":battle.turn_count,"z_used":list(getattr(battle,"z_used",set())),
        "mega_used":list(getattr(battle,"mega_used",set())),"z_pending":getattr(battle,"z_pending",{}),
        "declarations":dict(session.state.declare),"callback_failure_count":len(getattr(battle,"_callback_failures",[])),
        "participants":[{"controller":getattr(part.player,"key",None),"team":getattr(part,"team",None),
                         "active":[str(mon.model_id) for mon in part.active],
                         "pokemon":[{"id":str(mon.model_id),"name":mon.name,"species":str(mon.species),
                                     "base_species":str(mon.base_species),"hp":mon.hp,"max_hp":mon.max_hp,
                                     "status":mon.status,"toxic_counter":mon.toxic_counter,"boosts":dict(mon.boosts),
                                     "held_item":str(getattr(mon.item,"name",mon.item) or ""),
                                     "ability":str(getattr(mon.ability,"name",mon.ability) or ""),
                                     "volatiles":dict(mon.volatiles),"tempvals":dict(mon.tempvals),
                                     "moves":[{"name":m.name,"pp":m.pp} for m in mon.moves],
                                     "native_origin":dict(mon.native_origin or {})}
                                    for mon in part.pokemons]} for part in battle.participants]}
result={"label":QA_LABEL,"candidate":config["candidate"],"pid":os.getpid(),"game_dir":str(SOURCE),
        "module_source_attribution":modules,"battles":battles,"read_only_observation":True}
path=RELEASE/("runtime-"+QA_LABEL+".json")
assert not path.exists()
path.write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2,default=str)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
print("ITEM_REPAIR_RUNTIME_OBSERVED",QA_LABEL,"battles",len(battles),"source",config["candidate"])

"""Private QA operator transport; never logs authentication input."""
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import socket
import sys
import time

ART = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
config = json.loads((ART / 'runtime-private.json').read_text())
plan = json.loads((ART / 'plan.json').read_text())
assert config['tag'] == plan['tag']
assert config['ports'] == plan['ports']

def receive(connection, seconds=1.0):
    """Collect available server output without printing authentication data."""
    end = time.monotonic() + seconds
    chunks = []
    connection.settimeout(.2)
    while time.monotonic() < end:
        try:
            data = connection.recv(65536)
            if not data:
                break
            chunks.append(data)
        except socket.timeout:
            pass
    output = b''.join(chunks).decode('utf-8', errors='replace')
    for key in ('staff_username', 'staff_password', 'secret_key'):
        output = output.replace(config[key], '[private]')
    return re.sub(r'\x1b\[[0-9;]*m', '', output)

with socket.create_connection(('127.0.0.1', config['ports']['telnet']), timeout=5) as connection:
    receive(connection)
    connection.sendall(('connect ' + config['staff_username'] + ' ' + config['staff_password'] + '\r\n').encode())
    login = receive(connection, 2)
    if 'incorrect' in login.lower() or 'failed' in login.lower():
        raise RuntimeError('Private operator authentication failed')
    if sys.argv[1] == 'cookie-isolation':
        suffix = config['tag'][-8:]
        command = ("@py from django.conf import settings; "
                   f"settings.SESSION_COOKIE_NAME='item_repair_qa_{suffix}'; "
                   f"settings.CSRF_COOKIE_NAME='item_repair_qa_csrf_{suffix}'; "
                   "print('OCTOBER_COOKIE_ISOLATION', settings.SESSION_COOKIE_NAME, settings.CSRF_COOKIE_NAME)")
    elif sys.argv[1] == 'command':
        command = sys.argv[2]
    else:
        raise SystemExit('Unknown private staff operation')
    connection.sendall((command + '\r\n').encode())
    output = receive(connection, 2)
    print(output)
    connection.sendall(b'quit\r\n')

"""Submit ordinary socket batches, retaining complete results and bounded console output."""
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import sys
import time
import uuid
sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8',errors='replace')
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
steps=json.loads(sys.argv[1])
job={'id':str(uuid.uuid4()),'steps':steps}
assert not (ROOT/'socket-job.json').exists()
(ROOT/'socket-job.json').write_text(json.dumps(job),encoding='utf-8')
deadline=time.monotonic()+120
while time.monotonic()<deadline:
    try:
        result=json.loads((ROOT/'socket-result.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
        if result['id']==job['id']: break
    except (FileNotFoundError,json.JSONDecodeError): pass
    time.sleep(.1)
else: raise RuntimeError('Socket batch timeout')
checks=[]
for step,entry in zip(steps,result['results']):
    output=entry['output']
    passed=all(text in output for text in step.get('contains',[])) and all(text not in output for text in step.get('excludes',[]))
    checks.append({'player':entry['player'],'command':entry['command'],'contains':step.get('contains',[]),'excludes':step.get('excludes',[]),'passed':passed})
    lines=[line.strip('â•‘ ').rstrip() for line in output.splitlines() if not line.startswith(('â•”','â•š','=='))]
    print(entry['player']+' '+entry['command']+' '+('PASS' if passed else 'FAIL'))
    print('\n'.join(lines)[:1600])
path=ROOT/'socket-checks.json'
records=json.loads(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')) if path.exists() else []
records.extend(checks)
path.write_text(json.dumps(records,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
assert not result.get('error'),result.get('error')
assert len(result['results'])==len(steps)
assert all(check['passed'] for check in checks),'Ordinary socket expectation failed; preserve evidence and inspect'

from django.db.backends.signals import connection_created

def _guard_connection(sender, connection, **kwargs):
    """Reject fallback database aliases, hosts or search paths before any writes."""
    expected = _config['database']
    if (connection.vendor != 'postgresql' or connection.settings_dict.get('HOST') != expected['HOST']
            or str(connection.settings_dict.get('PORT')) != str(expected['PORT'])
            or connection.settings_dict.get('OPTIONS', {}).get('options') != expected['OPTIONS']['options']):
        connection.close()
        raise RuntimeError('QA connection attempted an unauthorized database configuration')
    with connection.cursor() as cursor:
        cursor.execute('SELECT current_schema()')
        if cursor.fetchone()[0] != _config['schema']:
            connection.close()
            raise RuntimeError('QA connection attempted a non-QA schema')

connection_created.connect(_guard_connection, dispatch_uid='item_repair-qa-schema-guard', weak=False)

"""Operate only the new task-owned loopback PostgreSQL test cluster."""
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import socket
import subprocess
import sys

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
DATA = ROOT / 'postgres'
BIN = Path(r'C:\Program Files\PostgreSQL\16\bin')
STATE = ROOT / 'postgres-fixture.json'


def command(*args):
    with (ROOT / 'cluster-control.log').open('a', encoding='utf-8') as output:
        subprocess.run(args, stdout=output, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, check=True,
                       creationflags=subprocess.CREATE_NO_WINDOW if os.name == 'nt' else 0)


if sys.argv[1] == 'start':
    assert not DATA.exists(), 'Never reuse or overwrite an unrelated cluster'
    with socket.socket() as listener:
        listener.bind(('127.0.0.1', 0))
        port = listener.getsockname()[1]
    command(str(BIN / 'initdb.exe'), '-D', str(DATA), '-U', 'pf2_october_test',
            '-A', 'trust', '--encoding=UTF8', '--locale=C')
    state = {'port': port, 'dsn': f'postgresql://pf2_october_test@127.0.0.1:{port}/postgres',
             'data': str(DATA), 'stopped': False}
    STATE.write_text(json.dumps(state, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')
    command(str(BIN / 'pg_ctl.exe'), '-D', str(DATA), '-l', str(ROOT / 'postgres.log'),
            '-o', f'-h 127.0.0.1 -p {port}', '-w', 'start')
    print('Started new task-owned loopback test cluster')
elif sys.argv[1] == 'launch':
    state = json.loads(STATE.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    assert Path(state['data']).resolve() == DATA.resolve()
    assert (DATA / 'PG_VERSION').read_text().strip() == '16'
    assert not (DATA / 'postmaster.pid').exists()
    result = subprocess.run([str(BIN / 'pg_ctl.exe'), '-D', str(DATA), 'status'], capture_output=True)
    assert result.returncode == 3, 'Only launch our prepared, stopped task fixture'
    with socket.socket() as listener:
        listener.bind(('127.0.0.1', state['port']))
    command(str(BIN / 'pg_ctl.exe'), '-D', str(DATA), '-l', str(ROOT / 'postgres.log'),
            '-o', f"-h 127.0.0.1 -p {state['port']}", '-w', 'start')
    state['stopped'] = False
    STATE.write_text(json.dumps(state, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')
    print('Started only prepared task-owned loopback test fixture')
elif sys.argv[1] == 'resume':
    state = json.loads(STATE.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    assert Path(state['data']).resolve() == DATA.resolve() and state['stopped']
    assert (DATA / 'PG_VERSION').read_text().strip() == '16'
    assert not (DATA / 'postmaster.pid').exists()
    command(str(BIN / 'pg_ctl.exe'), '-D', str(DATA), '-l', str(ROOT / 'postgres.log'),
            '-o', f"-h 127.0.0.1 -p {state['port']}", '-w', 'start')
    state['stopped'] = False
    STATE.write_text(json.dumps(state, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')
    print('Resumed only this task-owned test cluster for the complete test gate')
elif sys.argv[1] == 'stop':
    import psycopg2
    state = json.loads(STATE.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    assert Path(state['data']).resolve() == DATA.resolve()
    with psycopg2.connect(state['dsn']) as connection:
        with connection.cursor() as cursor:
            cursor.execute("SELECT nspname FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname NOT IN ('public', 'information_schema') AND nspname NOT LIKE 'pg_%'")
            assert not cursor.fetchall(), 'A disposable schema was not cleaned up'
            cursor.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND c.relkind IN ('r','p')")
            assert cursor.fetchone()[0] == 0, 'Test tables escaped into the public schema'
    command(str(BIN / 'pg_ctl.exe'), '-D', str(DATA), '-m', 'fast', '-w', 'stop')
    state.update(stopped=True, disposable_schemas_remaining=0, public_tables=0)
    STATE.write_text(json.dumps(state, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')
    print('Stopped only task-owned cluster; no disposable schemas remain')
else:
    raise SystemExit('Use start or stop')
